stem.text: In an experiment to demonstrate a stationary wave, two microwave transmitters, emitting waves of wavelength $4\,\text{cm}$, are set facing each other, as shown.

stem.alt: Two microwave transmitters labelled transmitter, one at the left and one at the right, with a detector between them. A double-headed arrow labelled d runs from the left transmitter to the detector.

stem.text: A detector is moved along a straight line between the transmitters. It detects positions of maximum and minimum signal. The detector is a distance $d$ from the left-hand transmitter.
Assume that both transmitters are at antinodes of the stationary wave.
Which row gives a value of $d$ for a maximum and for a minimum?
